name: 2018-2c-recuperatorio
title: Super 4 in a Line
description: A Connect Four variant on a 6x7 board where red and yellow alternate dropping chips into columns and the winning condition (horizontal, vertical, diagonal or any combination) is configured when the game is created; a full board with no winner is a draw. The student must build the game from scratch with TDD.

design.notes: The configurable winning strategy (and its combinations) is a natural place for composable strategy objects instead of flags, the alternating colors and the playing/won/draw phases form a small state machine, and detecting four in a line over rows, columns and diagonals invites shared collection-based traversal rather than four copies of a loop.
